//: Where you would buy this if you were not making it. A recipe can sit at several counters — noodles are not only sold by the sushi-and-ramen place — so `counters` on a recipe is a list. `categories` here is only a fallback: a recipe that names no counters lands at whichever counters claim its category, so nothing is ever orphaned. These fallbacks are deliberately coarse and are meant to be replaced recipe by recipe.
